task: 4-class motor imagery classification (left hand, right hand, feet, tongue)
circularity_risk: NONE - MI task labels are experimental instructions assigned before recording
key_findings: All 7 configurations significantly outperform the mean-predictor baseline (25.18%) at p < 0.001
PCA-32 alone (0.3213) marginally outperforms Joint-2312 with M27 weights (0.3200) — delta = -0.0013
Joint-2312 fusion provides NO measurable improvement over the best individual block (PCA-32)
Joint-264 raw concat (0.3211) ≈ Joint-2312 (0.3200) — fusion adds no value on this task
Best single block: PCA-32 (0.3213), which is an engineered feature, not a learned representation
No individual learned foundation model (CBraMod, EEGPT, V2) outperforms PCA-32
ablation_conclusion: Joint-2312 fusion does NOT measurably improve over individual blocks for MI classification. The best performer (PCA-32) is a simple engineered feature. This contradicts claims that learned representations add value.
